messages.content: Hello! Welcome to Novora Support. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I am calling regarding my delayed refund for order #9821. My email is alex@novora.test.
Thank you for verifying Alex. Let me check your order details right away.
I see the delay is due to bank backlog. As an apology, I can provide a $25 store credit.
I have created case ticket #REF-4092 for you. Have a great day!
Thank you so much, that solves it!
